| description = The [[Lich of Miragul]] wanders the underground caves in Everfrost and is generally KoS.

As part of the FA quest, paladins have someone charm the [[Lich of Miragul]] turn in [[Miragul's Phylactery]], which spawns the true Miragul (53 Necro). Procs the 1500 point Venril Sathir lifetap, but not nearly as often as VS; you don't need rune/ch chains for this, just a reasonably reactive cleric (don't rely on torpor ask me how i know this) and a tank that can survive at least two in quick succession. The lifetap's proc rate is inconsistent... one fight he tapped our tank 3 times in relatively short order (hence the torpor comment) and then murdered the rest of us with more lifetaps, but on the next fight there were no lifetaps over a similar fight time. Magic resistant but not immune; fire spells landed just fine.

Currently on a week respawn timer with a 5 day variance.

The above respawn timer may no longer be true. See the [[Lich of Miragul]] wiki page for more details. It is now likely that his spawn is exactly 7 days.

Did not despawn after nearly 4 hours after turning Phylactery in, at which point we killed him. He may not depop (similar to Ixiblat)

Very easy if lucky on proc rate, duoed by a 53 Epic Mage and 60 Manastone Cleric.

He was able to be slowed after a few attempts by a 60 Enchanter.
